{{Vanilla|Clay}}
{{Infobox auto}}
'''Clay''' is a soft block found in water. In [[Matcha Flavoured]] its clay balls are the source of [[brick]]s, which are needed for the [[oven]] and for bowls, and clay can be made from [[mud]].

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
Eight mud around a [[Glass Bottle#Water bottle|water bottle]] make 4 clay; the empty bottle is given back.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/clay_from_mud_and_potion.json}}</ref>

=== Other sources ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
{{Uses}}
* Clay balls are cooked into [[brick]]s on [[Kindling|kindling]] or in a [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]] ({{Value|Brick|cook_time}}).
* A clay block fired in a mud kiln becomes [[terracotta]].
